mean_cn: n.坚持不懈；毅力；韧性；不屈不挠的精神
mean_en: the quality that allows someone to continue trying to do something even though it is difficult
sentence: Perseverance is a very important quality in learning English.
sentence_trans: 坚持不懈在学习英语的过程中是一项很重要的品质。
